notes.title: The new update Farabel 1.2 has been deployed!
notes.content:
New update Farabel 1.2 has been deployed! [url=store.steampowered.com/app/364200/Farabel/]Pick up your copy right now[/url] and save 50%!

[img]https://farabel.com/_external_files/images/DailyRun_Marketing800.png[/img]

This update features a new game mode, changes and bug-fixes!
So what's new in Farabel 1.2?

- A new Challenge game mode: Fight a new battle every day, and compete with other players in a new season every month!
- Critic : a new abilty available to all units
- 1 new Steam achievement
- Russian language support

Discover the new game mode in this short and brutal very first season!

[img]https://farabel.com/_external_files/images/DailyRun_Marketing800_Season_screenshot.png[/img]

- battle objectives & rules
- play new races, like the ancient gods!
- earn Prestige points
- level-up your Rank
- improve your Rating in the multiplateforme leaderboard!

[img]https://farabel.com/_external_files/images/DailyRun_Marketing800_Season_1.png[/img]

Season 1 now live! Good luck and have fun :)

If you like Farabel, and if you want to see more content in the future, don't forget to write a Steam review!

Enjoy.

notes.title: War Drums Free Update is Live!
notes.content:
Hello Farabel fans,

[img]http://farabel.com/_external_files/images/WarDrums.png[/img]

The very first Farabel update, [b]War Drums[/b], has been deployed! This update features bug-fixes, changes and new game modes!

New:
[list]
[*][b]Orcs are now a playable race![/b] (and it's very fun!)
[*][b]Classic Mode[/b]: Build your own army by purchasing units and war machines. Destroy your enemy as quickly as possible and with the least amount of casualties to become a hero! This game mode allows you to play through a series of different battles.
[*][b]Defence Mode[/b]: Build your own army by purchasing units. In Defence mode, you take on an endless army which is impossible to beat. Survive for as long as possible and kill as many enemies as you can to become a hero.
[*]Collect [b]Badges[/b] by completing the objectives for each different game mode.
[*]5 new Steam achievements
[/list]

[img]http://farabel.com/_external_files/images/Badges.png[/img]

Changes:
[list]
[*]The Sleep ability has been changed. It now has a cooldown of 3 turns, a maximum of 3 uses per battle and — perhaps most importantly — it now lasts 2 turns. Also, inflicting damage on a sleeping unit will no longer wake them. 
[/list]

[img]http://farabel.com/_external_files/images/WD_Screenshot_1.png[/img]

Bugfixes:
[list]
[*]The death of an Imp used to make several Surprise Imps appear on the same hexagon. We’ve fixed that! 
[*]Killing an enemy with a counter attack would sometimes stuck the game.
[*]Some units would be unable to move or attack after waking from a spell-induced slumber. We’ve fixed that too! 
[*]Pushing a unit out of the battlefield would sometimes crash the game, but not anymore.
[/list]

[img]http://farabel.com/_external_files/images/WD_Screenshot_2.png[/img]

If you like Farabel, and if you want to see more content in the future, don't forget to [url=store.steampowered.com/app/364200/]write a Steam review[/url]!
Enjoy.

notes.title: Farabel release and beta 0.8!
notes.content:
[b]Strategy gamers, rejoice, because Farabel will be released on October 14th![/b] 

[img]http://www.farabel.com/_external_files/images/FarabelRelease640.png[/img]

Meanwhile, Farabel beta version 0.8 is now live for testers. So what's new in this version? Steam achievements, new musics, and a lot more!

News
- Steam achievements 
- Steam cards 
- New ability for the son of Azuk 
- Additional battle musics

Changes
- Abilities now display AOE 
- New texture for the magic sword of Cendor 
- A little bit of animation in the Main Menu 
- Proofreading of English and French texts 
- many more... 

Bugs
- pb with mouvement hexs that were not displayed 
- many more...

Again thank you for your support and your help and enjoy the game!

notes.title: Farabel is now in Beta! 🎉
notes.content:
So what's new in this version? New logo, new art, 13 new battles and a lot more!

News
- New logo ! 
- 6 New pieces of art 
- New Campaign screen. Now, you can unlock Stars and challenge battle stats! 
- 13 new battles, available when the player unlock stars

Changes
- A cool Main Menu 
- A very cool Credits screen! 
- New hexs for Catapults and Ballistas 
- New stuff in the Victory sceen (Star, New stat and Priestress) 
- Change the Unit overlay colors 

Bugs
- In victory screen and Character screen, music was not affected by volume preferences 
- Rage ability now reset properly after Cendor use the Turn Back Time ability on a unit.


Again thank you for your support and your help and enjoy the game!

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/22635566/69a5f3d0a176113a5577d1f574382de397e83028.png[/img]

notes.title: Farabel Alpha 0.6 is out!
notes.content:
So what's new in this version?
New content, an Advisor, a new default ability for your units and a lot more!

New
- Your personnal Advisor, available at the beginning of each battle.
- If you lose a battle, the Advisor will give advice.
- 1 new battle.
- 4 new units (Son of Azuk, Skeleton Orc, Imp, Monster from Hell)
- 2 new enemy abilities
- 1 new ability (Rage) added to all allied units, available 1 time per battle and per unit.
- Credits Screen 
- New Move and Selection hexagons
- New model for Cendor

Changes
- Options screen improvements
- Character screen improvements
- new Tutorial
- Optional camera blur turned off by default
- Units Highlight removed
- Removed the number of remaining turns for unit effects

Bugs
- The Old God Boss special attack now properly ends


Things are going to get serious for us in about 1 month. Beta is coming!

notes.title: Farabel reached alpha 0.5!
notes.content:
[b]So, what's new in Farabel Alpha 0.5?[/b]

New content & graphics improvements!

New
- 4 new battles
- 9 new units: Orak, Orc Shaman, Orc War Chief, Mage, Elemental, Skulls Thrower, Mounted goblin, Troll and Engineer
- 5 new abilities: Back in Time, Invocation, Shamanic Heal, Nature Heal, Rock
- Extended story and new dialogs
- Units can now move/attack/use abilities in any order you wish
- Player can use Ballistas and Catapults

Changes
- graphics improvements
- Tactical advices are disabled until alpha 0.6
- Tutorial is disabled until alpha 0.6

Things are moving forward and [b]beta is expected for August[/b]. Stay tuned!
